name: intellij-java-kotlin-navigation
description: IntelliJ-style interface / implementation / override navigation ('1 implementation', '↑ Interface' hints) in Java and Kotlin. Works on top of any language server (e.g. JetBrains' 'Java and Kotlin by IntelliJ IDEA').
author: Andreas Huth

intellijNav.enabled.description: Enable IntelliJ-style inheritance navigation (hints, hover, commands).

intellijNav.languages.description: Language IDs for which navigation hints are computed.

intellijNav.inlayHints.description: Show clickable IntelliJ-style hints at the end of declarations, e.g. '1 implementation' or '↑ EntityRepository'. Cmd/Ctrl+Click to navigate.

intellijNav.codeLens.description: Show the same links as CodeLens above each declaration (plain click, but takes an extra line).

intellijNav.clickLineNumber.description: Clicking the line number of a declaration with implementations/super methods navigates there (instead of selecting the line).

intellijNav.showOnTypes.description: Also show icons on class/interface declarations (implemented by / implements).

intellijNav.refreshDelay.description: Delay in ms after an edit before the icons are recomputed.

intellijNav.maxConcurrentRequests.description: Maximum number of parallel language-server requests per file.
